name: Old King Halvard
bio: Reigned for fifty years and outlived every rival. Not planning to stop now.
notes: From the owner's T-pose uploads (2026-11-01, "found some new ones"): an unrigged textured GLB, rigged here from T-pose landmarks (arms level; the manifest's landmarks, read off front and side views). Named here; the owner reviews it on the grip and portrait sheets. Not King Aldric (blue velvet robe): an old king in red and gold with a long white beard and a cape. Rebuilt 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b) from the re-rigged download "T Pose Old medieval king around 50 60" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used).
